name: Otter.ai
summary: Otter.ai records a meeting and writes a transcript and a summary. A business user can review what was said without replaying the whole call.
paragraphs: Otter.ai records a meeting and writes a transcript and a summary. A business user can review what was said without replaying the whole call.
whyItMatters: Use it to catch action items from a meeting, and correct the transcript where the audio was unclear.
